`coforge-agent-manifest.v1.schema.json` is a verbatim copy of
[`docs/agent-manifest/coforge-agent-manifest.v1.schema.json`](https://github.com/lrm-lab/coforge/blob/cfdadb4753e2775411d223c43c5cb2cf71224b65/docs/agent-manifest/coforge-agent-manifest.v1.schema.json)
in [lrm-lab/coforge](https://github.com/lrm-lab/coforge) at commit `cfdadb4753e2775411d223c43c5cb2cf71224b65`
(sha256 `2b730ea8fb16dcd3018aff890aa30050c9fc6fb4458778cacec24045aa60c4f7`; unchanged since commit `4b81763c`, where the template had it).
The schema states structure and bounds only; the coherence rules in
[Actions and schemas](https://github.com/lrm-lab/coforge/blob/cfdadb4753e2775411d223c43c5cb2cf71224b65/docs/agent-manifest/actions.md) are checked separately in `test/manifest.test.ts`.
When CoForge publishes a newer schema, replace this file and update this note.
